items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: The person to judge is 'My sister', who is a family member, not a jazz musician or industry figure covered by the controlled vocabulary.

ctx.x: Before we get to New York on this contract -- my mother and these kids are in Jamaica now -- I had to go by the way of Philadelphia because Philadelphia is a cheaper place to live than New York. So I take my mother, my niece and my sister by way of Philadelphia coming into New York and I got them a place to live in Philadelphia for a couple of months while I get some more money together so they could come into New York. And I had to find a place in New York for them. Then I found a place in New York for them and…

my sister, my little sister she was in the mind she wanted to get married almost at the time she got to New York. She run into somebody and he was a prize fighter and I didn't know it and they didn't tell me nothing about it until after they were already engaged to get married, and they got married. I can't do nothing about it, the only time I could do something about it is when they needed some money to pay the rent that he couldn't fight and get no money to pay. So my mother through me and I said I would do…
So altogether she turned out to surprise me because she turned out to be a Jehovah's Witness and I didn't want her to do that, I was disappointed that she changed from
